title: Conversational English (starter)
description: Speaking-partner pack. Skills are conversational competencies; 'problems' are speaking scenarios graded on rubric, not exact answers.

problems.prompt: Scenario: You meet a new classmate. Introduce yourself: your name, where you're from, and one hobby.
Scenario: You are starting a new job and meet your team. Introduce yourself in two or three sentences: your name, your role, and one thing you are looking forward to.

criteria: states role or what they do
mentions something they look forward to

problems.prompt: Tell me about your last weekend in three or four sentences. Use the past tense.

criteria: uses past tense verbs correctly at least three times

problems.prompt: Describe a journey or trip you once took: where you went, how you travelled, and one thing that happened.
Some people think students should wear uniforms to school. What do you think? Give your opinion and one reason.

criteria: uses an opinion phrase such as 'I think' or 'in my view'

problems.prompt: Your friend says city life is better than village life. Do you agree or disagree? Answer in three sentences with a reason and an example.
